about: Holds a page to one measure and centres it in whatever holds it, with a gutter down each side.

gutter.about: The gutter down each side, and a flush container that takes it away. The outer tile stands for the page, so the gutter is the room between it and the content.
gutter.title: Gutter

measures.about: Every measure, from the narrowest to the whole of the room, the measure a column of text is read at among them. A measure wider than the room fills it.
measures.title: Measures

prose: Running text at the measure it is read at.
title: Container
